name: pipexp
description: Reports every coding-agent session to your PipeXP board: stage, time, tokens, snags and questions for a person.

interface.shortDescription: See every agent run live on your PipeXP board
interface.longDescription: PipeXP puts each Codex session on a live board: which stage it is in, how long it has been there, what it cost in tokens, what slowed it down, and questions it needs a person to answer. Hooks report on their own, with no changes to your skills. Secrets, home folders and machine names are scrubbed before anything leaves this machine.
defaultPrompt: Where is this session on my PipeXP board?
Ask a person on PipeXP before merging.
